items.title: “Can we get those 40 welcome kits to San Francisco any sooner?”

post.text:
“Can we get those 40 welcome kits to San Francisco any sooner?”

Here’s how we built a merch store you can talk to:

• GPT-Live-1.1 reads out the rush fee and delivery estimate.
• The Decisions API scores damage to a returned mug.
• WebMCP lets any agentcall the store’s cart tools.

items.title: More photos should add detail to a scene without slowing down rendering.

post.text:
More photos should add detail to a scene without slowing down rendering.

Test-time Baking from @NVIDIA Research trains a compact neural network to reproduce how a model combines information across photos. This speeds up rendering of new viewpoints while maintaining quality comparable to the original model, even as more photos are added.

Paper, code, weights, and demo for our #NeurIPS2026 spotlight: https://t.co/PeiLOJnFow
